title: The words for a matrix where a tier has no rules of its own, on the tier's Pricing tab
stem: Which words should a tier's Pricing tab (and the New Tier page) show?

options.t: "Uses previous tier", the same words as the grid, as the PRD says
"Same as previous tier", as the design draws

context: The PRD says the tab uses the grid's words, "Uses previous tier", and defines that phrase in its Terminology section. The design's tier pages show "Same as previous tier". The price details have a similar question of their own (question 26).
where: PRD Story 2 (a tier's Pricing tab) and Terminology; Tiered Pricing design canvas, pictures 2.11 to 2.17, 2.32, 2.44
